t: The Cooke and Lewis CSB60a built-in single electric oven provides reliable cooking performance for any kitchen installation. This 65 litre capacity conventional oven, finished in sleek stainless steel, offers four essential cooking functions including a twin grill and plate warming. It features a double-glazed door and overheating protection, with a hard-wired connection to ensure a secure power supply. It comes supplied with a baking tray, trivet, oven light and shelf.
b: W x D x H: 595 x 535 x 595mm
